name: AOMPLSAomlibRegressor
description: Native AOM-PLS operator and component selection (nirs4all-methods)
longDescription: Uses the installed nirs4all-methods native global AOM selector. Internal K-fold validation selects the operator and component count. Historical AOM_lib one-SE, SPXY/holdout and built-in preprocessing options are unsupported; add preprocessing explicitly before this model.

parameters.name: center
parameters.description: Center predictors and target in the native model

parameters.name: random_state
parameters.description: Seed for shuffled internal K-fold validation
